What to review

  • Scan all 32 supported provider definitions; search or filter by saved configuration.
  • Open a provider. Key presence, permission, catalog discovery and inference readiness have separate meanings.
  • Inspect its models and known model limits. OpenRouter free models share one pool; unknown allowance stays unknown.
  • Manage connection opens the existing provider settings with keys masked. Choosing an enabled model uses existing manual selection.
  • On phone, Back restores the provider list. Workspace navigation preserves the unsent draft.

Evidence and limits

Focused Chromium and Linux WebKit tests cover desktop/phone browsing, search/filter keyboard controls, no-key, permission-off, stale/auth-error, unknown quota, shared quota, masked settings, model selection, draft preservation and a synthetic account-state replacement. No inference requests or unapproved external requests are allowed.

No logo/type selection, new gateway, OAuth integration, billing source or production visual deployment. Physical iPhone keyboard behavior and real-provider quota/authentication are outside this slice. Earlier broad screenshots remain historical checkpoints.

Source and exact test results are in draft PR #34 and its provider-intelligence README. The broader Blackout visual approval remains pending.
